criteria.requirement: Add explicit datetime.timezone value handling in actual DeepDiff dispatch and DeepHash preparation. Compare native fixed offsets (including negative, fractional hour and microsecond offsets), ignoring display names exactly like Python equality. Different offsets report values_changed, including nested and ignore_order structures, and canonical hashes must agree with equality. Preserve dynamic tzinfo/other-class type rules and existing datetime normalization; do not claim arbitrary timezone-rule comparison.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
